items.title: Eli Lilly is trouncing Nvidia — and the weight-loss drug trade is beating AI again
items.summary: Since its Oct. 6 record, Nvidia has shed more than $1.7 trillion in market value. Eli Lilly has added more than $250 billion over the same stretch, a gain topped only by Apple among the market's biggest stocks.

items.title: Could Jensen Huang actually make a comeback as Nvidia CEO?
items.summary: Al Root, Barron's Associate Editor, joins the 8:30 hosts, Julie Hyman and Pras Subramanian, to discuss former Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang's potential return to the AI chip giant and what a leadership comeback could mean for the company.

items.title: Jensen Huang was a great CEO, but he's not untouchable
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi argues that the push by SpaceX CEO Elon Musk and other tech figures to bring Jensen Huang back to the helm of Nvidia (NVDA) ignores corporate governance and national security questions that no CEO is exempt from.

items.title: Should Nvidia stock be a buy ahead of earnings?
items.summary:
Nvidia (NVDA) stock has been under pressure since the Jensen Huang affair hit the news. With the AI chip giant's next earnings report out Nov. 17, is the recent pullback a buying opportunity?

Barron's associate editor Al Root joins "The 8:30" hosts Julie Hyman and Pras Subramanian to break it down.
